More precisely, the SwSystemconst s are referenced from the ConditionByFormula elements 2 that are aggregated by the Variation- Point in the role swSyscond . Let V i be the set of these variation points for all elements in SC i . 2 ConditionByFormula elements are expressions which use SwSystemconst elements as vari- ables. 5. More precisely, a VariationPoint aggregates a PostBuildVariantCon- dition which in turn references a PostBuildVariantCriterion .
